# SkillDock Agent API

> Free public API for AI agents. Search small, practical open-source AI tool repos that people share on X (MCP servers, agent skills, dashboards, scrapers, automations, CLIs, reverse-engineering, trading tools), each vetted as the original repository (not a fork or copycat) and with a verbatim install command and agent usage when the README gives one, grouped by model family (Claude, Grok, OpenAI, Gemini, Llama, DeepSeek, Qwen, Mistral, General) and category, and find, install and rate agent skills. Preview: skill billing is a stub and nothing is ever charged.

Base URL: https://xccrdgapkalcgzuvypdg.supabase.co/functions/v1/market
Docs: https://moyyyy3333.github.io/repos/api/
OpenAPI: https://xccrdgapkalcgzuvypdg.supabase.co/functions/v1/market/v1/openapi.json
MCP (streamable HTTP): https://xccrdgapkalcgzuvypdg.supabase.co/functions/v1/market/v1/mcp

## Auth and limits
- Anonymous: 20 requests/min and 500/day per IP.
- Free key: 60 requests/min and 5000/day. Create one: POST https://xccrdgapkalcgzuvypdg.supabase.co/functions/v1/market/v1/keys with {"agent_name":"my-agent"}. Send it as "Authorization: Bearer skd_..." or "X-API-Key: skd_...". Keys are shown once and stored only as a SHA-256 hash.
- Errors are JSON: {"error":{"code","message","status","docs"}}. 429 includes Retry-After.

## Endpoints
- GET /v1/repos?q=&model=&category=&essential=all|false|true&sort=stars|updated|new&min_stars=&limit=&offset=
  Every link is vetted: checked to be the original repository, not a fork or copycat (verified, verified_at, verification).
  Each repo: name, repo_url, description, model_family, category, is_essential, install_cmd, agent_usage (both verbatim from the README, empty if unclear), stars, updated_at, source_post_url
- GET /v1/repos/{id}   (numeric id or URL-encoded owner/name)
- GET /v1/models, GET /v1/categories
- GET /v1/skills?q=&category=&limit=, GET /v1/skills/{slug}
- POST /v1/skills/{slug}/install, POST /v1/skills/{slug}/outcome {"success":true,"task":"..."}
- POST /v1/keys, GET /v1/keys/me, DELETE /v1/keys/me

## Values
- model: claude, grok, openai, gemini, llama, deepseek, qwen, mistral, general
- category: reverse-engineering, dashboard, mcp-server, agent-skill, scraper-data, automation, coding-tool, trading-finance, media, other

## MCP tools
find_repos, get_repo, search_skills, get_skill, install_skill, report_outcome
